```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Load necessary libraries
library(dplyr)
library(dunn.test)
library(Hmisc)
```

Subset data
```{r}
#titers <- read.csv("GroupedtiterR10.csv", sep=',', header=T)

titers <- read.csv("Titers-lineage-only.csv", sep=',', header=T)

r10titers <- subset(titers, Type!= "HK68")
```


```{r}
# Prepare the output file for capturing the analysis results
sink("TCID50 Pairwise by host and by genotype.txt")

  # Kruskal-Wallis test
  cat("Kruskal-Wallis Test:\n")
  kruskal_result <- kruskal.test(TCID50 ~ Host, data = r10titers)
  print(kruskal_result)
  
  # Check if Kruskal-Wallis test is significant before proceeding to Dunn's test
  if (kruskal_result$p.value < 0.05) {
    cat("Since p-value is less than 0.05, proceeding with Dunn's test for pairwise comparisons.\n")
    
    # Dunn's test for pairwise comparisons
    dunn_result <- dunn.test(r10titers$TCID50, r10titers$Host, method="bonferroni")
    print(dunn_result)
  } else {
    cat("Kruskal-Wallis test p-value is not less than 0.05. No significant difference detected among groups.\n")
  }
  
  cat("\n\n") # Add extra line for readability
  
  cat("Mann–Whitney U Test BY HOST GENOTYPE:\n")

# Extract the two groups
group1 <- r10titers %>% filter(HostStrain == "BALB/C") %>% pull(TCID50)
group2 <- r10titers %>% filter(HostStrain == "C57BL/6") %>% pull(TCID50)

# Remove NAs
group1 <- group1[!is.na(group1)]
group2 <- group2[!is.na(group2)]

mw_result <- wilcox.test(group1, group2, alternative = "two.sided", exact = FALSE)

print(mw_result)

cat("\n")


# Redirect output back to the console
sink()

```

```{r}

sink("TCID50_Ancestral_vs_evolved_pairwise_MWU_results.txt")

cat("Pairwise Mann–Whitney tests: HK68 vs Adapted (R10) within each host\n\n")

hosts <- unique(titers$Host)

for (h in hosts) {
  cat("Host:", h, "\n")
  
  hk <- titers %>% 
    filter(Host == h, Treatment == "HK68") %>% 
    pull(TCID50)
  
  r10 <- r10titers %>% 
    filter(Host == h, Treatment != "HK68") %>% 
    pull(TCID50)
  
  # Remove NA values
  hk <- hk[!is.na(hk)]
  r10 <- r10[!is.na(r10)]
  
  # Mann–Whitney U test
  if (length(hk) > 0 & length(r10) > 0) {
    test <- wilcox.test(r10, hk, alternative = "two.sided", exact = FALSE)
    
    cat("  n_HK68 =", length(hk), " n_R10 =", length(r10), "\n")
    cat("  W =", test$statistic, "  p =", test$p.value, "\n\n")
  } else {
    cat("  Not enough data for this host.\n\n")
  }
}

sink()

```
